title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Pavel Dunn · June 2024
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Pavel called to check on the Small Business Circle meeting time. Conversation moved to shop updates.

That old monster of a baking sheet from the wholesale order? Warped, wouldn’t fit anything. I was about to chuck it in the scrap pile, but then I looked at the second oven—the smaller one. Grabbed the tin snips, cut a foot off the length. Now it fits perfectly in there. Use it for proofing the morning rolls. No sense wasting good metal.

The central prep table. That wobble was driving me spare every time you leaned into a knead. Found a bracket in the back, shimmed the leg with a scrap of leather, tightened it all down. Solid as a rock now. Should’ve done it months ago.
No new equipment needed for either. He’s planning to attend the next circle meeting if the morning bake is done in time.
